findings.fix: Add an appropriately namespaced `@[simp]` theorem `spanningTreeBasis_apply` giving `spanningTreeBasis T e = IsFreeGroupoid.SpanningTree.loopOfHom T (IsFreeGroupoid.of e.val.hom)`.

summary: The generic spanning-tree API is misplaced under profinite topology and its principal basis definition lacks the equation needed to use it as the advertised concrete loop basis.
